Class NativeKeyboard

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeKeyboard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Keyboard
public final class NativeKeyboard extends Object implements Keyboard
The M5Stack Cardputer's Keyboard, implemented by compiler intrinsics over M5StackCardputer.Keyboard.
